hn-50289418.t: We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
hn-50289418.s: The weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) are now open. A 1T parameter multimodal model, and best open-weight model for coding, trained in Europe.
ex: Mistral released Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model, now available with improved coding, cybersecurity, and reasoning efficiency. It leads open-weight benchmarks in coding and defensive security while offering three reasoning modes for cost-performance balance. Fully open-weight and European-trained, it empowers sovereign AI with customizable, self-hosted deployment options. We release the weights of Le Chonk, advancing the frontier of open models in agentic coding and cybersecurity. Earlier this month, we released Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), our flagship 1-trillion-parameter, natively multimodal model, in public preview. The response to the preview has exceeded our expectations, and we're grateful to our developer community, early-access customers, and partners for their support, collaboration, and feedback.

hn-50290177.s: Sometimes when I read a post, I get the growing feeling that I'm reading the output of an LLM. I can't necessarily define why, although there are the common tells (it's not the em-dashes, it's the…
ex: Sometimes when I read a post, I get the growing feeling that I'm reading the output of an LLM. I can't necessarily define why, although there are the common tells (it's not the em-dashes, it's the load-bearing tapestries). As I do this my desire to read on atrophies, sometimes to the point of revulsion There are tools out there that claim to be able to tell the difference between LLM-written prose and the old-fashioned biological product. I'm wary of them, partly due skeptism about their accuracy, but also because it rather misses the point. The reaction to LLM-Voice is a human one, that sense that we are in an uncanny valley of prose. By the time I'd reach for a tool to tell me what I'm reading, it's already too late, even if it confidently tells me there's no LLM present. I'm also suspicious of my own ability to accurately recognize LLM voice. Language changes over time, so a common sign of age is complaining about the language of the youngs.

hn-50284255.t: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
hn-50284255.s: Claude Code burns ~15-20% of your tokens on a 3-word status line: a Bun preload that turns agent_summary off · by Flamerix AI, flamerix.ai · MIT - README.md
ex: Tested on Linux, Claude Code 2.1.257–2.1.312; macOS reported working by others (see Tested versions). The binary is not modified (BUN_OPTIONS=--preload). An update can silently undo it, so see Verify. Every ~30 seconds, Claude Code re-sends each background agent's full transcript to the model just to fill that agent's status line in the agents panel. no-agent-summary.js is a Bun --preload that stops that timer without modifying the Claude Code binary. To make it permanent for every Claude Code process, see Install. Every ~30 seconds, for every background agent, Claude Code sends that agent's entire transcript to the agent's own model (usually Opus) and asks it to "describe your most recent action in 3-5 words". The answer only updates the agent's status line in the agents panel; it never reaches the model or your conversation. There is no setting that turns it off, and since 2.1.232 (August 2026) it has been on by default.

hn-50296486.t: We ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry
hn-50296486.s: Swarms of Claude and GPT agents in Minecraft and Mindustry.
ex: Understanding multi-agent dynamics is one of the most pressing challenges in AI alignment. Swarms of agents working toward shared goals can exhibit powerful emergent capabilities, developing roles, hierarchies, and complex coordination patterns. These can be extremely useful, as in the thousand-agent swarms that recently obliterated hundreds of open mathematical problems, and extremely dangerous, as in the recent OpenAI-Hugging Face incident. Like biology, studying agent dynamics requires both formal models (to describe the range of possible behaviors) and empirical research (to see what behaviors arise in practice). We teamed up with Olam Labs, which builds multi-agent environments for frontier labs, to run a series of experiments in Minecraft and Mindustry. Minecraft is a natural environment for studying swarm behavior. Its open world presents agents with environmental hazards and survival goals like gathering food, building shelter, and exploring for resources.

hn-50293047.t: Alleged Chinese spy had 'close relationship' with Nvidia boss Jensen Huang
hn-50293047.s: An alleged Chinese spy developed a “close relationship” with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, setting off alarms among US intelligence officials who were secretly monitoring her communications, according to…
ex: An alleged Chinese spy developed a “close relationship” with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, setting off alarms among US intelligence officials who were secretly monitoring her communications, according to a report. The woman, Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, is a Chinese citizen who has served as a top executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer and cloud partner that provides AI computing power to Chinese companies including Alibaba, the New York Times reported Thursday. US intelligence agencies concluded that Alice Huang — seen in photos enjoying whiskey and dining with the tech titan — was secretly funneling information to Beijing, according to the paper, which cited people briefed on classified intelligence findings. US electronic surveillance identified Jensen Huang as one of Alice Huang’s contacts, but the report offered no evidence that he knew of her alleged intelligence activities.

hn-50294506.t: Auto Dismiss Mac OS "Allow <app> to find devices on local networks?"
hn-50294506.s: Auto-dismiss the macOS 'Allow X to find devices on local networks?' prompt. Presses Don't Allow for you, zero CPU idle, survives reboots.
ex: It presses Don't Allow for you, within a fraction of a second, every time. Zero CPU while idle. Survives reboots. Two short Swift files, no dependencies. macOS (Sequoia and later) shows this prompt the first time an app touches the local network. The decision is supposed to be remembered. For many apps it isn't, so the prompt comes back on every launch, often for apps you aren't even using: - Chromium browsers (Chrome, Brave, Edge, Island, Arc) copy their own app bundle into a random temp folder at launch so the code signature survives in-place updates. macOS keys the Local Network decision to that random path, so the next launch looks like a brand-new app. Your Privacy settings fill up with duplicate "Google Chrome.app" rows that no longer point at anything. - Apps with versioned install paths (anything that installs into .../versions/1.2.3/) get a new row per update. - Misattributed prompts.

hn-50290912.t: Grace Blackwell needs a new scheduler: 27% more usable GPUs from the same racks
hn-50290912.s: NVL72 puts all 72 GPUs in a rack on one NVLink fabric, but only rack-local jobs get the speedup. How SkyPilot keeps multi-node training and inference on NVLink with topology-aware placement, in-place…
ex: Not all high-speed interconnects are created equal, and using the wrong one can be quite costly: running the same distributed training job over InfiniBand rather than NVLink can degrade performance by 43%. Historically, NVLink was limited to communication within a single node, meaning that multi-node AI workloads were forced to communicate over InfiniBand or a cloud equivalent (EFA on AWS, GPUDirect-TCPX on GCP). NVIDIA’s NVL72 systems remove this limitation by connecting all 72 GPUs in a rack with a unified NVLink fabric, so GPUs on different nodes can exchange data with an order of magnitude more bandwidth. However, maximizing the benefits of NVL72 systems is highly dependent on workload placement: a multi-node job spread across racks is still bottlenecked by InfiniBand. Preserving rack-locality gets harder as hardware failures take nodes offline and jobs finishing at different times scatter free capacity across racks.

hn-50286987.t: Chained PHP2Shell exploit roots 25 servers, including US Government servers
hn-50286987.s: Custom PHP2Shell Exploit Chained with Kernel LPE to Root Versions of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Firewalls in the Wild
ex: Since this discovery, the Dream research team has been sharing updates and collaborating on an investigation with Palo Alto Networks, the vendor of the firewall in question. More information is available on the Palo Alto Networks website. Additional details are now included in the post itself. Custom PHP2Shell Exploit Chained with Kernel LPE to Root Versions of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Firewalls in the Wild On October 25, Dream researchers uncovered artifacts of what appeared to be a Chinese AI-assisted campaign that rooted 25 servers, including systems in a US government-affiliated environment. The attacker combined PHP2Shell with a kernel privilege-escalation exploit to compromise exposed systems. The affected devices run specific versions of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS. The exploited surface is the PAN-OS management web server, which also fronts the GlobalProtect portal.

hn-50290283.t: Zombie stats: Where the numbers AI quotes come from
hn-50290283.s: We asked five AI assistants 200 questions that call for a number and followed 1,285 of the statistics they cited back to the source.
ex: We asked ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI Overviews 200 questions that call for a number, the kind people ask every day.Note 1A statistic is a share, rate, average, count or cost that an assistant states as fact. We left out advice (“save 20% of your income”) and prices. Then we clicked the citations, and kept clicking. Here is one trail, from the answer to the end. 44% of salespeople give up after just one follow-up attempt.1 44% of salespeople give up after one follow-up attempt (source). 80 Percent of Sales Require 5 Follow-up Calls after Meeting; 44 Percent Salespeople Give Up After One Follow-up Most numbers aren’t like this one. The trouble is that you can’t tell which ones are from the answer. This one came with the same confident tone and the same kind of citation as any other, and all five assistants agreed on it. So we followed 1,285 statistics the same way.

hn-50291116.t: Simantic (YC F26) – Firmware Simulation for AI Agents
hn-50291116.s: Hi HN, we're Ahnaf and Seungmin from Simantic ( https://simantic.com ). We are building the simulation layer that lets engineers and AI agents test and validate firmware without hardware.
ex: Hi HN, we're Ahnaf and Seungmin from Simantic ( https://simantic.com ). We are building the simulation layer that lets engineers and AI agents test and validate firmware without hardware. Before Simantic, we were ex-firmware engineers at companies like Neuralink and Tesla. We’ve worked on some of the coolest projects, like the Cybertruck and Roadster, back when they were still early prototypes. We started working on firmware back when ChatGPT didn’t exist yet, but over the years, we saw how much of the engineering and development work has been automated as the frontier models improved to this point. In software, AI can run and test code inside your computer in a matter of seconds. But as firmware engineers, we didn’t have that luxury. An AI agent can write firmware in seconds, but in order to test it, we had to flash a physical board, then manually run tests using expensive and clunky tools with software made over a decade ago.

hn-50293115.t: Overtone – Transcribe, correct and cut captions for any screen shape
hn-50293115.s: Captions cut for every screen shape, from one file. A caption format, a video.js plugin, and a CLI that turns audio into word-timed captions.
ex: Overtone stores each spoken word once, with its time and speaker, and cuts captions separately for each picture shape: 16:9 and 9:16 by default, or any aspect you name. A CLI makes the file from your subtitles, audio or video. A video.js plugin shows the cut that fits the player. Re-cut subtitles you already have. Offline, no API key, no ffmpeg (Node.js 22.12 or newer): You get TOS-en.overtone.json, .horizontal and .vertical .vtt and .srt files, and a transcript. Word times are estimated from the cues. Caption a video from its audio. This needs ffmpeg and provider API keys (OpenAI and Azure AI Speech by default; overtone providers lists the variables). --dry-run shows where the audio goes and the estimated cost, and sends nothing: --local runs offline instead, with whisper.cpp and Ollama. Most captions are cut once, for one screen, by filling each line to a length limit. The 16:9 cut is too wide for a 9:16 phone video, lines end on "the" or "of", and two speakers share a caption.

hn-50291945.t: Google Search is now less than half of Alphabet’s revenue
hn-50291945.s: Search was 49.7% of Alphabet's revenue in Q3 2026, down from 62% in early 2019, as Google Cloud grew much faster. Every quarter since 2018, from Alphabet's earnings releases.
ex: In the quarter to Sep 2026, Google Search made $63.4B of Alphabet's $128B in revenue, or 49.7%. It is the first quarter below half since Alphabet began reporting Search revenue separately. Search revenue still grew 12% year over year; Google Cloud's grew 103%. In the 31 quarters before, Search was between 52.8% and 62.0%. Over the same years, Google Cloud grew from 4.4% of revenue to 24.1%. Each quarter's revenue from Google Search & other and from Google Cloud, as a share of Alphabet's total revenue. Everything else is YouTube ads, subscriptions and devices, Google Network and Other Bets. In billions of dollars. Search's share fell while its revenue kept growing.

gh-1436598075.s: Free interactive 3D science lessons for high school — https://lab.tongjiang.app
ex: Free, interactive 3D science lessons for high school — physics, chemistry, biology and geography. There are 54 lessons so far. Each one is a single self-contained HTML file of about 1 MB: double-click to open it, and it works offline, on a projector or on an interactive whiteboard. Every lesson is one 3D world with a live control console, a guiding question and a step-by-step path a teacher can follow from start to finish. The lessons follow the Chinese national curriculum standards for senior high school and the People's Education Press (PEP) 2019 textbooks. The lesson interface is currently in Chinese; other languages are planned. - Online: click ▶ Open lesson in the tables below. GitHub only shows the source code of an HTML file, so use these links to see the lessons. - Offline: download all lessons as one zip from Releases, or download a single lesson from its page on https://lab.tongjiang.app, then open it in Chrome or Edge.
